about_the_game:
Take on the challenge as you build and manage your dream horse ranch. Ride in competitions to rise through the ranks and become one of the best, or focus on creating the best experience for your guests to attract them in the masses. Become a renown breeder that sells horses all over the world, or just live a cozy life with horses on the estate you always dreamed of. Whatever you choose, the world is yours!



Utilizing a mixture of large-scale, top-down and detailed, first-person building, you can construct the horse ranch of your dreams. No matter if this means creating a breathtaking resort that leaves guests wanting to stay forever, or your personal equestrian retreat where you can recover from thrilling competitions, or the stress of everyday life.



Owning horses and running a ranch is more than just riding. Breed, train and trade horses realistically as you plan the financing of your next building project or horse purchase. Open your ranch to visitors and pick activities that match the interests of your guests. Hiring the right staff not only impacts many aspects of your ranch but also eliminates gameplay that feels grindy or like a chore.



Besides being able to expand your ranch, gaining money and reputation lets you unlock various areas that you can explore freely. This lets you relax while riding out and experiencing the beautiful nature.

name: EQUIRE
short_description: Dive into this immersive equestrian simulation and experience realistic horseback riding. Build your dream ranch and establish deep bonds with your horses. You are the boss! Manage staff and guests, or focus on challenging competitions. Breed, trade and raise foals as you choose your own destiny.
